profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer with PhD in Computational Biology
profile.summary: Sr. Software Engineer with extensive experience designing and building LLM architecture, AI agents, data pipelines, and ML models. Skilled in developing data-driven strategies that deliver actionable business insights and optimize workflows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I design and deploy scalable data systems supporting clinical research, LLM applications, and ML workflows. My work bridges AI engineering, backend development, and infrastructure automation to accelerate insights and impact.

◦ Built a multi-agent product for clinical trial data and documents using LangChain and LangGraph, giving trial sponsors self-serve, natural-language access to trial data and protocols.
◦ Extended this agent system into a proactive risk-monitoring system using Celery, Celery Beat, and Celery chords to run agents on recurring schedules, continuously surfacing emerging risk signals across clinical trials instead of relying on manual review.
◦ Implemented fine-grained access control using PostgreSQL row-level security (RLS) and dynamic, runtime Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) grants, enforcing per-user and per-tenant data isolation for secure multi-tenant access.
◦ Containerized backend and agent components as independently scalable services with asynchronous REST APIs, deployed on Kubernetes with automated CI/CD
◦ Owned scalable PostgreSQL databases and modular data ingestion pipelines that unify heterogeneous clinical trial datasets, serving as a key liaison between data pipeline and infrastructure teams.
◦ Developed demographic-based ML models for biomarker discovery in colorectal neoplasia, achieving 89% accuracy and influencing clinical trial design.
◦ Built a pipeline that processes actigraphy data to extract features for predicting disease status
◦ Created a data augmentation workflow to improve insights for underrepresented demographics to enhance business performance and  improve representation.
◦ Streamlined analytics workflows by automating PowerPoint report generation from 250M+ Snowflake rows, enhancing decision-making and saving hours of manual effort per cycle.

positions.title: Senior Bioinformatics Consultant
positions.locationName: South San Francisco, California, United States
positions.description:
I help biotech and Pharma companies meet their research and business needs by offering domain expertise and bioinformatics/data science skills.

- Machine learning
- Genomics (Cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, immune repertoire, etc)
- Dockerized Nextflow pipeline development
- Data visualization
- Project management
- Project scoping, proposal writing

positions.title: PhD Candidate
positions.description:
Computational biologist with a formal training in statistical machine learning. 6 publications, 1 manuscript under review. 

Developed Python-based algorithms to identify genetic variations that contribute to Alzheimer's disease  (AD) risk: 
- Analyzed whole exome sequencing data (82 million variants across ~5k samples) and identified potential genetic modifiers of APOE in AD
- More than half of the genes tested modulated neurodegenerative phenotype in Drosophila AD models
- Built a patient risk stratification model using Adaboost-SVM that may be used on top of the usual APOE-based AD risk assessment (AUC = 0.79 for APOE2 carriers and AUC = 0.71 for APOE4 carriers)

Developed algorithms to analyze TCGA cancer germline samples:
- Collaborated with 10+ other labs to produce, quality control, and analyze ~10k whole genome sequencing samples of cancer patients spanning 33 cancer types as part of the TCGA PanCanAtlas Germline Working Group
- Built a polygenic risk model to stratify individuals at risk for colon cancer such that individuals at risk may be identified for earlier diagnostic screening (AUC = 0.90 in discovery cohorts, AUC = 0.88 in replication cohorts)
- Interrogated the codon-level co-occurrences of germline variants and somatic mutations and their role in cancer

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Took part in 1) identification of metabolic differences between M1 (inflammatory) and M2 (anti-inflammatory) macrophages and 2) characterization of tumor-associated macrophages and their roles in breast cancer, working with oncology surgeons to screen for potential drug targets to be used clinically.

2 publications
